items.title: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express
items.summary: North Korean hackers launch memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, while xStocks plans to add hundreds of Hong Kong-listed equities in the coming weeks.
